exposure: Implementation of standard Emergency Obstetric and Neonatal Care Services (CEmONC)
Hospitals with all nine CEmONC signal functions
outcome: Number of women referred for blood transfusions
cohort: 15 public hospitals in four developing regions of Ethiopia (Somali, Afar, Beneshangul Gumz, and Gambella)
finding: The availability of CEmONC signal functions in the supported hospitals did not change the occurrence of maternal death and stillbirth.
